_comment: Settings for the backend scripts. Edit on GitHub; the next scheduled run uses the new values.

weather._comment: Thresholds for the one-line summary. rain chance in %, rain in mm.

dam._comment: Dams shown in the app, in this order. 'match' is a pattern for the name in the KSNDMC report.

manual._comment: If KSNDMC scraping is broken for a long time, set enabled to true and type the values from the KSNDMC report. The app then shows them as 'Entered by hand'.
